name: Female Preachers
overview: Scripture affirms that God calls both sons and daughters to prophesy and share His word, as seen in Acts 2:17, highlighting the Spirit's work upon all flesh without distinction. Psalms 68:11 describes a great company that publishes the word, implying a broad participation in proclaiming God's message. The example of Priscilla in Acts 18:26 demonstrates women teaching and explaining the way of God, while Titus 2:3 instructs older women to be teachers of good things, emphasizing their role in spiritual instruction. Galatians 3:28 underscores the unity and equality of all believers in Christ, transcending distinctions such as male and female.
